verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships several of its own background processes. Patterns runs the Loop agent on a schedule over the trace backlog and records recurring problems with suggested fixes. Online scoring evaluates production traces automatically and asynchronously as they are logged, and Topics continuously classifies traces without manual review. These are fixed, purpose-specific background jobs rather than a general way for users to define their own autonomous automations. Running evals on every pull request depends on the user's external CI, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-defined automation or workflow builder, documentation of configurable schedules and triggers beyond Patterns, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the background features.
